landing.title: Your shop, organized end to end

how.title: How it works
how.who: Customers with an email who agreed to receive promotions get it: {reachable} of {total} customers with special dates.
how.when: It goes out on its own every morning (around 9 a.m. Mexico City time), a few days before each date: as many as that date's notice (7 unless you change it).
how.validity: Each email has a personal code. Your customer messages you on WhatsApp with the code (or shows the email in store): you look it up in Discounts, apply the discount and mark it as used.
how.once: Only one email per date each year.
how.unsubscribe: Each email has a link to stop receiving promotions; if your customer uses it, their consent is removed.
